Leah (CSM): Quick sync — prepping external comms for Redwood onboarding SLOs. Need a short, non-alarmist blurb + an example calc for customers.
Marco (Ops): I ran a 10m sim with overlapping model imports: two latency spikes (p95 ~900ms for 8m total) + one 90s outage from a retry storm. Numbers below.
Sam (Support): I can draft the blurb. Keep the structure: cause, measured impact, mitigation, next steps (how to claim credits).
Ivy (Renewals): Renewal ask: if projected credit exposure >10% in 30d, notify Renewals so we can offer a customer walkthrough.
Omar (Finance): Finance prefers "we will apply" language until credits are finalized. We also recommend a predictable cap for onboarding windows — propose 15% per 7 days as a starting point.
eng-bot: sim snapshot attached (3512350050) :white_check_mark:
Marco (Ops): Worked example: 
- Incident A: 90s outage -> uptime credit 7%
- Incident B: latency p95 breach -> 5%
- Incident C: latency spike -> 3%
Stacked = 15% -> with cap (15%/7d) final = 15%
Leah (CSM): Draft blurb v0: "During onboarding we observed transient latency and one brief outage related to import retries. We will assess your onboarding window against the SLA and apply any eligible service credits. If you’d like a walkthrough of the calculation, please schedule time with your CSM."
Sam (Support): I'll add a short worked-calculation appendix and a link to the credits calculator: https://redwood.example/sla/credits-calc?customer=example
Ivy (Renewals): I'll add the >10%/30d flag to the renewal playbook and provide a script for the CSM to offer a renewal-impact review.
Omar (Finance): Finance action: confirm cap and opt-out wording for enterprise customers in 48h. Use "default cap" language.
Leah (CSM): Action items: Sam publish blurb + appendix (EOD), Marco attach sim logs and enable onboarding tag in calculator (tomorrow), Omar confirm cap (48h), Ivy update renewal playbook (72h).
eng-bot: daily uptime digest attached (3512350148)
Leah (CSM): Thanks team — will fold this into the onboarding playbook and keep tone reassuring.
